title: DOLE to issue labor advisories on workplace safety as El Niño looms

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) will issue four labor advisories outlining safety measures for employers and workers amid extreme heat during the El Niño phenomenon, Labor Secretary Francis Tolentino said. The guidelines will cover workplace safety and health, including measures to protect workers exposed to high temperatures, particularly those working outdoors. READ: Drought forecast to hit more areas until March 2027 – Pagasa Tolentino said employers must implement appropriate safeguards while workers must also follow safety measures intended to protect their health.
